findings.fix: Call the actual retained2:11 sentence a report.
findings.before_rationale: The continuing enumeration culminates in 'we hear them speaking in our own tongues about the mighty deeds of God.' It identifies the listed peoples and residents as the hearers voicing this question, rather than identifying them as the apostolic speakers or turning their places into a later mission itinerary.
findings.after_rationale: The continuing enumeration culminates in 'we hear them speaking in our own tongues about the mighty deeds of God.' It identifies the listed peoples and residents as the hearers making this report, rather than identifying them as the apostolic speakers or turning their places into a later mission itinerary.
findings.resolution: Changed only the final rationale and matching current assessment; original previous reason and source/target bodies unchanged.

observations: 2:11 supplies the regional hearers first-person tongues report; it does not make them the apostolic speakers or later missionaries.
12:22 is the acclamation response,not narrator affirmation.17:6–7 identifies the Jason proceeding and accusations,not an amount or Paul paying.
17:19–20 gives a concrete novelty request;17:32/34 contrasts reactions without equating hear-again people with named believers.17:33 remains a brief unpaired departure.
18:7/16:14–15 shares named God-worshiper and house association but differs in explicit invitation/lodging.18:17 Sosthenes is not identified from1Cor1:1.
19:5–6 supplies the counted men actions without identifying about-twelve as the apostolicTwelve.21:7/28:14 and21:16/16:14–15 preserve separate port durations,hosts and invitations.

27:28/29 relates soundings to narrated fear/precautions without adding measurements.28:13/27:13–14 specifies the same wind direction in different legs with different outcomes,not identical wind,event or route.
27:5 Myra route and28:12 Syracuse three days remain unpaired; no generic port/duration credit.
